'''Circle Culu''' was a group of [[Jedi Seer]]s during the [[Mandalorian Wars]], aligned with the [[Jedi Covenant]]. They were likely named after [[Miraluka/Legends|Miraluka]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Shoaneb Culu]] since some WatchCircles were named after Jedi who had fallen in the Sith War.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide" />

In [[3963 BBY]], [[Haazen]] claimed that [[Krynda Draay]] was meditating with Circle Culu in the upper levels of the [[Draay Estate]].<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 32">[[Knights of the Old Republic 32|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 32]]</ref> All members of the Circle were either killed or arrested after [[Vindication|Operation: Vindication]].
